questions.question: A student ranks 29th from the left and 45th from the right. How many students are there?
questions.explanation: Add the left and right ranks and subtract one for the person counted twice: 29+45−1 = 73.

questions.question: A student ranks 44th from the left and 58th from the right. How many students are there?
questions.explanation: Add the left and right ranks and subtract one for the person counted twice: 44+58−1 = 101.

questions.question: A student ranks 13th from the left and 60th from the right. How many students are there?
questions.explanation: Add the left and right ranks and subtract one for the person counted twice: 13+60−1 = 72.
